subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is Ava from <Picture 1>, a character sheet whose face close-up, front, side and back panels depict the same young woman: long straight black hair with loose face-framing strands, calm dark eyes, a small beauty mark beside one eye, a slender build, a light taupe sleeveless tank top, matching slim belted trousers, light gray sneakers and a faint pale scratch on her left arm; it supplies her facial identity, proportions, hairstyle and current outfit.
<Subject 2> is Madison from <Picture 2>, a character sheet whose face close-up, front, side and back panels depict the same young woman: shoulder-length wavy brown hair with bangs, brown eyes and a soft but cold smile, wearing a pale pink long-sleeve button-collar pajama top with white piping and a chest pocket, matching drawstring trousers and beige slippers; it supplies her facial identity, proportions, hairstyle and current outfit.
<Subject 3> is the post-apocalyptic ocean from <Picture 3>, a storm-lashed seascape with a heavily rusted, listing vintage ocean liner, two red-and-black funnels, broken masts and rigging, dark gray-blue waves, floating wooden wreckage, a wrecked small boat, storm clouds and cold light breaking through the overcast sky; it supplies the ship, sea, debris, atmosphere and lighting direction.
<Subject 4> is the giant shark from <Picture 4>, a multi-view creature sheet depicting the same animal with dark slate-blue rough skin, a pale gray-white underside, black eyes, a tall dorsal fin, broad pectoral fins, gill slits and a massive mouth crowded with triangular teeth; the panels provide its head, side, dorsal and open-jaw appearance without reproducing the sheet layout.

summary:
[reference generation] On the storm-damaged deck of <Subject 3>, <Subject 2> deliberately forces <Subject 1> toward the tilted railing while <Subject 4> patrols below; after a close threat, <Subject 2> pushes <Subject 1> from the ship, and the camera follows her fall toward the rising shark.

detailed_description:
Cinematic semi-realistic 3D rendering preserves the reference facial proportions and clothing, with soft skin shading, fine moving hair strands, woven fabric folds and coherent contact shadows. The characters, corroded metal deck and storm-wet ocean share the same cold volumetric light, rain-misted atmosphere and physically based materials.

[Shot 1] In an extreme wide shot, the rusted ocean liner from <Subject 3> tilts steeply across the frame, its red-and-black funnels and broken masts rising against heavy black-gray clouds while frigid waves burst against the hull and jagged wooden wreckage. Near the upper deck rail on the right side of the composition, <Subject 1> stands with her back close to the open side, her long black hair whipping across her taupe tank top and matching trousers; facing her, <Subject 2> blocks her escape, her pale pink pajama set and beige slippers standing out against the wet gray deck. The camera performs one slow continuous push along the slanted deck toward the two figures and ship rail, passing damp railings and swaying loose cables, then tilts slightly downward at the end to reveal churning water beneath them. Between the waves, the tall dark dorsal fin of <Subject 4> briefly cuts through foam, then disappears under the hull. The liner groans, metal twists under stress, huge waves strike the ship, and wind howls through the rigging.

[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the camera cuts to a close shot of the two women, initially holding still beside the tilted rail. <Subject 2> grips <Subject 1> near the upper chest and shoulder area, their clothing pulled by wind; Madison's lips form a cold smirk while Ava faces her with tense lips and widened eyes, her hands braced without striking. Over the violent creaking of the ship and a short mocking chuckle from Madison, <Subject 2> (S1) says in en-US American English, <d>[English] Big sister, go on down and feed the fish.</d> Immediately after the line begins, with her expression still cold, Madison drives both palms hard into Ava's shoulders. The camera makes a short sharp forward push with the impact. Ava's upper body rocks backward, her feet slip on the canted wet deck, and fabric pulls at the grip while the hull emits a deep wrenching groan.

[Shot 3] At 00:08.000, the camera cuts to a full high-angle shot and rushes downward with <Subject 1> as she loses balance and flips backward over the ship's rail. Her arms swing out, her long black hair streams upward, and her taupe outfit claps in the wind; she takes one sharp involuntary breath as she falls. The camera tracks vertically past the dark hull and white spray, keeping Ava centered while the tilted ship edge recedes above and the gray-black sea rises to fill the frame. Below her, <Subject 4> surfaces through the waves with its slate-blue dorsal fin raised, pale underside exposed, head lifted and jaws spread wide to show rows of triangular teeth. The shark's open mouth remains open as it rises through the final beat, framed directly beneath Ava but without contact before the clip ends. Rushing wind surrounds her, the ocean roar swells violently, and spray bursts upward from the waves.

overall_soundscape:
The scene is dominated by storm wind, thundering waves striking the hull, rain-like sea spray and the continuous groan of stressed metal. Fabric snaps and scrapes during the grab, followed by a sharp scuff on the wet deck at the push. Ava's single sharp intake of breath and the rushing fall wind lead into the sudden louder roar of surf beneath her.
